# Embed a complete config and verify show-config output.
exec iso-config-embedder embed -c config.yaml -o $WORK/openshift-iso-builder-patched $ISO_BUILDER_BIN_RAW
stderr 'Configuration embedded into'

exec $WORK/openshift-iso-builder-patched show-config
stdout 'OpenShift Version:\s+4.18'
stdout 'Release Image:\s+quay\.io/openshift-release-dev/ocp-release:4\.18\.0-x86_64'
stdout 'Architecture:\s+x86_64'
stdout 'Pull Secret:\s+\*\*\*'
stdout 'SSH Keys:\s+1 key'
stdout 'FIPS:\s+Enabled'
stdout 'Rendezvous IP:\s+192\.168\.1\.100'
stdout 'Proxy:'
stdout 'HTTP Proxy:\s+http://proxy\.example\.com:8080'
stdout 'HTTPS Proxy:\s+https://proxy\.example\.com:8443'
stdout 'No Proxy:\s+\.example\.com,10\.0\.0\.0/8'
stdout 'Additional Trust Bundle:\s+present'
stdout 'NTP Servers:\s+ntp1\.example\.com, ntp2\.example\.com'
stdout 'OLM Operators:'
stdout 'local-storage-operator v4\.18 \(channel: stable\)'
stdout 'Additional Images:'
stdout 'quay\.io/example/image:latest'
stdout 'Network Configs:\s+1 config'
stdout 'Extra Manifests:'
stdout 'custom-config\.yaml'

-- config.yaml --
openshiftVersion: "4.18"
releaseImageURL: "quay.io/openshift-release-dev/ocp-release:4.18.0-x86_64"
pullSecret: '{"auths":{"example.com":{"auth":"dGVzdDp0ZXN0"}}}'
architecture: x86_64
sshKey:
  - ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABgQC1example test@example
fips: true
rendezvousIP: "192.168.1.100"
proxy:
  httpProxy: http://proxy.example.com:8080
  httpsProxy: https://proxy.example.com:8443
  noProxy: ".example.com,10.0.0.0/8"
additionalTrustBundle: |
  -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
  MIIDExample
  -----END CERTIFICATE-----
additionalNTPServers:
  - ntp1.example.com
  - ntp2.example.com
olmOperators:
  - name: local-storage-operator
    channel: stable
    version: "4.18"
additionalImages:
  - quay.io/example/image:latest
networkConfig:
  - interfaces:
      - name: eth0
        type: ethernet
        state: up
extraManifests:
  - name: custom-config.yaml
    content: |
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: ConfigMap
      metadata:
        name: custom-config
